tools.name: catpilot_list_tasks
tools.description: List all tasks from CatPilot storage. Each task includes its SMART fields, SMART score and computed Eisenhower quadrant.

status.description: Filter by status: open, done, or all (default: all)

quadrant.description: Only return tasks in this Eisenhower quadrant: q1, q2, q3 or q4

tools.name: catpilot_add_task
tools.description: Add a new task to CatPilot. Optionally capture the SMART fields so the task lands in the right Eisenhower quadrant.

due.description: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD format) — the Time-bound part of SMART

goal.description: SMART Specific: what "done" concretely looks like

measure.description: SMART Measurable: how success will be verified

steps.description: SMART Achievable: the first concrete steps

why.description: SMART Relevant: why this matters now

importance.description: Eisenhower importance: High, Low or auto (default auto)

urgency.description: Eisenhower urgency: High, Low or auto (default auto)

tools.name: catpilot_set_task_smart
tools.description: Set or clear the SMART fields (goal, measure, steps, why) and Eisenhower axes of an existing task. Only the provided fields change.

goal.description: SMART Specific: what "done" concretely looks like

measure.description: SMART Measurable: how success will be verified

steps.description: SMART Achievable: the first concrete steps

why.description: SMART Relevant: why this matters now

importance.description: Eisenhower importance: High, Low or auto

urgency.description: Eisenhower urgency: High, Low or auto

tools.name: catpilot_task_matrix
tools.description: Return tasks organised into the Eisenhower Matrix (Q1 do now, Q2 schedule, Q3 delegate, Q4 drop), grouped by Overdue / Today / Next 7 days / Later / No date / Completed, plus coaching insights.

quadrant.description: Only return one quadrant: q1, q2, q3 or q4

tools.name: catpilot_task_focus
tools.description: Return a ranked 'what should I do next' list built from the Eisenhower Matrix, with a reason per task.
